name: Tiny Insulation Calculator & Building Science Engine
description: Building envelope thermal calculations, transient temperature simulations, empirical R-value estimation, and solar kiln psychrometric drying modeling for tiny homes, sheds, and small structures.

tools.name: apply_preset
tools.description: Applies a construction preset (e.g. 'van_build', 'code_min') to a specific scenario (A or B). This updates wall assemblies, insulation values, and other defaults.

suffix.description: The scenario suffix. Use '_A' for Scenario A (Standard) or '_B' for Scenario B (Comparison).

tools.name: set_dimensions
tools.description: Sets the building shape and dimensions. Updates the UI and recalculates surface areas.

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.description: Runs the passive thermal simulation for a specified duration and returns the temperature data series with executive summary statistics.

tools.name: get_detailed_results
tools.description: Retrieves the current calculated heat loss results for all active scenarios.

tools.name: estimate_r_value
tools.description: Estimate building component R-value using HVAC data and temperature measurements where internal construction is unknown.

tools.name: calculate_solar_kiln_performance
tools.description: Calculates solar firewood kiln drying time, glazing optical/thermal R-values, psychrometric air buoyancy, and financial ROI against a central air heat pump.

grossVolumeCuFt.description: Gross stacked wood volume in cu ft (12 = 1 basement bay, 42.7 = 1 pallet, 128 = 1 cord)

initialMcPct.description: Initial wood moisture content % on dry basis (e.g. 75 green, 50 semi-seasoned)

useBasementFinisher.description: True if finishing bound water (<26% MC) in indoor basement or conditioned space

splitDiameterInches.description: Average thickness/diameter of wood splits in inches

isUnsplitRound.description: True if logs are unsplit rounds with intact bark

numCollectors.description: Number of 36x96 transpired screen solar collectors attached to active box

collectorGlazingLayers.description: Layers of 6-mil UV film on solar collectors (1-3)

boxGlazingLayers.description: Layers of 6-mil UV film on pallet box walls (1-3)

totalFanCfm.description: Active fan ventilation airflow rate in CFM

chainedBoxesInSeries.description: True if multiple drying boxes are connected in series airflow

electricRatePerKwh.description: Local electricity rate in $/kWh (0.169 KY Power, 0.138 KY Co-op)

heatPumpCop.description: Seasonal Coefficient of Performance of central heat pump

cordsProcessedPerSeason.description: Total cords processed through kiln over 150-day winter

buildCostUsd.description: Total DIY solar kiln build cost in USD
